up: For the human single-protein target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL2061 (Retinoic acid receptor RXR-alpha), fetch up to 1000 activity records where the standard type is 'IC50' and a pChEMBL value is recorded. Return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID (from assays.chembl_id), target type (from target_dictionary.target_type), taxonomic ID (from target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (from activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (from activities.pchembl_value). Order the results first by molecule ChEMBL ID (ascending) and then by assay ChEMBL ID (ascending). Use the appropriate table relationships: activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id, assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid, activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, and activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Ensure target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens'.
sql: SELECT assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ON a.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON assays.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2061' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, assays.chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000;
